entry.title: Revolut Starts EURR Rollout With Bridge as Regulated Issuer
entry.summary: Revolut opens EURR to selected customers in three countries; Bridge reported €374 outstanding, compared with €394.5 million of Circle’s EURC.

entry.title: SEC Crypto Custody Rewrite Enters White House Review
entry.summary: The planned rule would cover advisers and investment companies and clarify digital-asset custody, following the withdrawal of a separate 2023 proposal.

entry.title: Robinhood Chain Tops Ethereum In Daily App Revenue
entry.summary: Applications on the two-month-old Arbitrum network earned $2.66 million in 24 hours, ranking second behind Solana, with a memecoin launchpad as the biggest single source.

entry.title: Bloomberg: Hyperliquid in Advanced Talks With Kraken Parent on US Perpetuals Push
entry.summary: The reported plan would route U.S. traders through CFTC-regulated Bitnomial, while neither Payward nor Hyperliquid has confirmed a deal.

entry.title: A Memecoin Called BONER Has Cornered Half the Tokenized Hims & Hers Float
entry.summary: The BONER/HIMS pool on Robinhood Chain holds 31,198 of the 58,714 tokenized Hims & Hers shares that exist. With the NYSE closed on Sunday night, the tokenized stock printed $132.64 against an equity that had closed Friday at $28.84.

entry.title: Ontology Halts Mainnet Block Production Over Potential Security Concern
entry.summary: The explorer’s last block was created at 4:24 a.m. ET, leaving transactions and Ontology-side bridge transfers unable to settle while validators review the network.

entry.title: Traders Make a September Rate Increase the Favorite as Bitcoin Holds $78,000
entry.summary: Polymarket prices a quarter-point hike at 55.5% after Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, against 28% on Friday afternoon. Bitcoin is down 0.7% on the day and 24.5% higher since the start of August, while 88 of the 125 largest non-stablecoin tokens fell.

entry.title: BitMine’s Staked ETH Holds at 5.07 Million as Treasury Grows
entry.summary: The $12.7 billion staked balance was unchanged in four weekly readings, while BitMine added 53,501 ETH and reported $335 million in annualized staking revenue.

entry.title: Sberbank Plans Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tether as Loan Collateral
entry.summary: The expansion is contingent on new crypto rules taking full effect and the Bank of Russia permitting the assets for public circulation.

entry.title: Strategy Restarts Bitcoin Buying With $370 Million Purchase
entry.summary: The company funded 4,603 BTC entirely with MSTR share-sale proceeds, leaving its $5.10 billion USD Reserve untouched for preferred dividends and debt interest.

entry.title: Fogo Mainnet Has Been Stopped For 46 Hours With No Restart Timeline
entry.summary: The chain has produced no blocks since Saturday, the halt notice is still the Foundation's most recent update, and an impersonator account is circulating a fake compensation vote.

entry.title: Balancer Warns Legacy V1 LPs to Exit After Pool-Draining Bug
entry.summary: Balancer said the deprecated pools are non-pausable, while SlowMist attributed a roughly $234,000 V1 drain to a fixed-point rounding flaw.

entry.title: CME Launches Crypto Index That Excludes Bitcoin and Ether
entry.summary: The 10-asset emerging benchmark is free-float market-cap weighted, with real-time pricing and London, New York and Asia-Pacific settlement variants.

entry.title: Cronos Restarts Chain by Rolling State Back to Before the Tectonic Exploit
entry.summary: Validators discarded almost 11,000 blocks, erasing the attacker's Cronos balances along with close to two hours of everyone else's transactions. The $6.29 million already bridged to Ethereum is beyond the rollback's reach.

entry.title: Ninth Circuit Says Kalshi Sports Contracts Aren’t Swaps, Splitting With Third Circuit
entry.summary: The panel affirmed the dissolution of Kalshi’s Nevada injunction after finding no likely federal preemption, reaching the opposite preliminary conclusion from the Third Circuit.

entry.title: Avici Says 1,685 Users Lost $500,859 In Rain Card Contract Exploit
entry.summary: Card issuer Rain says an attacker used an outdated version of its Solana contract, which a small number of programs were running. Both companies say affected users will be made whole.

entry.title: Bullish Provides USD.AI $100 Million Facility for GPU-Backed Loans
entry.summary: The commitment will fund more GPU loans; USD.AI’s API reported $265 million in loan reserves and $491 million in TVL.

entry.title: The Sandbox Pledges 1:1 SAND Repayment After Bridge Exploit
entry.summary: Treasury-funded compensation will use pre-incident balances on Base and BNB Chain without increasing SAND’s fixed 3 billion maximum supply.

entry.title: Stellar RWA Assets Outgrow Its DeFi Markets
entry.summary: RedStone puts tokenized real-world assets on Stellar above $3 billion in July, against DeFi value it measures at $213 million.

entry.title: Circle Adds Native USDC, EURC and CCTP Support to Plasma
entry.summary: The deployment gives developers Circle-issued dollar and euro tokens plus a burn-and-mint route for moving USDC across supported chains.

entry.title: Bitcoin Drops Below $78,000 After Warsh Speech
entry.summary: Bitcoin fell 3% over 24 hours to $77,955 by early Friday afternoon, leaving it 0.7% higher on the week after trading as high as $81,479.50 overnight. Gold fell 2.4% and U.S. equities turned negative after Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh told the Jackson Hole symposium the central bank has "work

entry.title: Bitwise Solana ETF Is First to Cross $1 Billion
entry.summary: Glassnode reported $138 million of Solana ETF inflows over 10 days, while BSOL captured nearly four-fifths of cumulative flows among six products tracked by Farside.

entry.title: Solana Validators Approve Doubling Disinflation in First Governance Vote, With Kraken Reversing Late
entry.summary: SGP-0002 passed with 176.29 million SOL in favor against 66.19 million opposed, hours after Kraken's largest validator switched roughly 8.1 million SOL from against to for.

entry.title: Ethena Plans Equity-Perpetual Basis Trades for USDe Backing
entry.summary: The announced rollout is still forthcoming, with the first partner exchange announcements and deployments expected in the coming weeks.

entry.title: Bitcoin Clears $80,000 As Schwab Adds Solana
entry.summary: Charles Schwab said Thursday it will add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to its retail crypto platform, and SOL rose 12.9% to lead the ten largest tokens. Ethena gained 21.9% after its research team proposed routing 95% of net revenue into ENA buybacks.

entry.title: Aave V4 Deposits Reach $806 Million After 30% Weekly Gain
entry.summary: EtherFi Cash was V4’s second-largest market at $257 million, while Aave V3 retained a much larger $31 billion deposit base.

entry.title: Moonwell Loses $8.7 Million To MAMO Price Manipulation On Base
entry.summary: The lending protocol cut borrow caps on every Base core market to 1 wei after an attacker inflated the price of a thinly traded collateral token and borrowed against it.

entry.title: StarkWare Says it Confirmed a Quantum Safe Bitcoin Transaction on Mainnet
entry.summary: The onchain record confirms a 10,000-satoshi input and 5,179-satoshi fee; claims about quantum resistance come from StarkWare and the method’s author.

entry.title: FRIEND Soars After Machi Big Brother Bids $1 Million For Friend.tech
entry.summary: FRIEND rose 28-fold within an hour of the post, and friend.tech fees jumped. Machi would buy the X account and the domain as the trading contracts have belonged to the null address since 2024.

entry.title: Ethena Proposes Sending All Net Revenue to ENA Buybacks
entry.summary: A new framework assigns protocol IP and value accrual to the Ethena Foundation, while a live vote would use effectively 100% of net revenue for ENA purchases.

entry.title: Coinbase and Better Take Bitcoin-Backed Mortgages Beyond the Waitlist
entry.summary: The product pairs a conventional home loan with a separate downpayment loan secured by pledged bitcoin and a second lien on the property.

entry.title: Schwab Crypto to Add SOL, AVAX and LINK to Bitcoin-and-Ether Lineup
entry.summary: The retail platform began rolling out in May, while a separate advisor-channel crypto service is targeted for mid-2027.

entry.title: Aave Opens iOS Early Access, Keeps Android and Web Waitlisted
entry.summary: The savings app supports bank and stablecoin deposits; a July proposal described swaps and foreign exchange as additions planned for 2026.

entry.title: 39 State Banking Groups Form BankChain Alliance for 2027 Blockchain Launch
entry.summary: The industry-owned network is still selecting a technology partner and would support tokenized deposits, stablecoins, smart payments and automated settlement.

entry.title: Core Lightning Tells Node Operators To Go Offline, With No Patch Published
entry.summary: The CLN team said operators who don’t upgrade should run their nodes --offline, but the fixed binaries aren’t out yet and the details of what they fix are under a two-week embargo.

entry.title: Unstoppable Skips ICANN Round, Refunds Web3 Domains
entry.summary: Founder Matthew Gould said the cost of taking web3 strings through ICANN was higher than what the company expected to recover in sales, six months after telling customers it would apply for all six of its original extensions.

entry.title: Cosmos Labs Urges EVM Chains To Halt As Shared Bug Drains Three Networks
entry.summary: The recommendation came six days after the patch shipped without a security advisory. KiiChain, one of three chains drained, says the sequence cost it 148 million tokens and that two of the three underlying defects remain unfixed upstream.

entry.title: Term Finance Permanently Shuts Meta Vaults After Exploit PeckShield Estimated at $8.5 Million
entry.summary: Withdrawals remain open, but Term’s Aug. 23 update did not quantify remaining vault assets and only said it would explore ways to address any shortfall.

entry.title: Bitwise Launches Self-Custodied Tokenized Stock Portfolio on Base
entry.summary: Only the Mag7X strategy is active at launch, holding four Coinbase-issued stock tokens; two additional Bitwise models remain marked ‘coming soon.’

entry.title: LayerZero Unveils ATLAS Exchange Engine
entry.summary: The headless exchange routes 75% of post-venue trading fees into ZRO buybacks and burns, and pays trading venues rebates of up to 65%.

entry.title: Pendle Oracle Move Liquidates $36 Million
entry.summary: A wallet bought yield tokens in a $9 million Pendle pool, pushing the principal token price down 2.8% and clearing out looped positions on a Morpho market carrying $52 million in borrows. No bad debt was incurred.

entry.title: Ex-X Product Chief Says Trade Buttons Coming
entry.summary: Nikita Bier left the role on Aug. 5. No X corporate account has ever announced a trading feature, and Bier said in February that the company is not handling trade execution.

entry.title: Bitcoin Stalls a Cent Below $80,000 as Altcoins Give Back Weekend Gains
entry.summary: Bitcoin touched $79,999.99 on Coinbase before easing, its highest level since May, while 80 of the 123 largest non-stablecoin tokens fell on the day. Total crypto market value declined even as bitcoin rose.

entry.title: Coinbase Launches Tokenized Stocks On Base
entry.summary: Four tokens covering Nvidia, Apple, Meta and Alphabet went live for non-US users, with about $4.5 million minted and $3 million of DEX liquidity on day one. Chainlink price feeds run 24/5 while the tokens trade 24/7.

entry.title: Eric Trump Denies New Coin Launch as TRUMP Jumps 38%
entry.summary: The rumor included an unverified claim about a 290 ETH Robinhood Chain wallet, while MELANIA gained 18.4% over 24 hours.

entry.title: The Sandbox Says It Contained Bridge Exploit That Minted Unbacked SAND on Base and BSC
entry.summary: Upbit and Bithumb froze SAND transfers under South Korea's user-protection law, with Upbit halting deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum — the chain the studio says was not affected.

entry.title: Solana Activates 350-Millisecond Slots on Mainnet
entry.summary: The first cut since Solana’s inception shortens the block-production window for validators and begins an epoch-by-epoch path toward 200 milliseconds.

entry.title: Bitcoin Posts Biggest Week Since 2024 as Trump Pushes Senate on CLARITY Act
entry.summary: Bitcoin gained 22.6% over seven days, its largest advance over any seven-day window since November 2024, after the president told crypto executives at the White House that Congress needs to pass market structure legislation.

entry.title: Circle Targets Sept. 16 for Arc Public Mainnet Launch
entry.summary: Official materials name Circle and 11 founding validators, while an Arc documentation page describes approximately 20 validators at launch.

entry.title: Illuvium Team Cuts Wages To Extend Runway
entry.summary: Co-founder Kieran Warwick says the reduction puts the Ethereum game studio past 12 months of runway, with the remaining team working almost entirely on its Overworld MMO.

entry.title: MANTRA Halts Chain, Blames Cosmos EVM Module
entry.summary: The Dubai-licensed RWA Layer 1 has been frozen since Thursday evening. MANTRA says the incident touched two wallets it controls and that no user funds were taken, and has not said whether anything left those wallets.

entry.title: Judge Keeps Sun's World Liberty Claims In Court
entry.summary: Justin Sun's individual claims will be heard in open court, and the two sides must negotiate which of the claims brought by his corporate plaintiffs go to a private arbitrator. No written order had been entered on the docket as of Thursday afternoon.

entry.title: Optimism Redirects $49.7 Million Airdrop Reserve After Late Deciding Vote
entry.summary: Test in Prod, a core development team that says it is fully funded by the Optimism Collective, supplied the 8.486 million OP vote that secured approval.

entry.title: Arbitrum Activates Elara With Optional Compliance Filters for Dedicated Chains
entry.summary: Chain owners—not ArbitrumDAO—control screening on dedicated networks, while priority fees remain off on Arbitrum One pending another vote.

entry.title: Trump Says CFTC Working to Onshore Hyperliquid
entry.summary: The president said CFTC Chair Michael Selig is working to bring the geoblocked perpetual futures venue into the US "in a fully compliant and legal fashion," sending HYPE and Hyperliquid Strategies shares up and CME and Cboe down.

entry.title: How Maple Finance Became the #2 Crypto Lender Behind Tether — Sid Powell Explains
entry.summary: Sid Powell, CEO and co-founder of Maple Finance, joins Chris Storaker on the Converge Podcast

entry.title: Bitcoin Tops $68,000 as Short Liquidations Hit $1.7 Billion
entry.summary: Ether gained 9% and total crypto market value rose 5.1% after the U.S. Treasury said it would at least double the size of its long-dated bond buybacks. Short positions accounted for 91% of the day's liquidations.

entry.title: HSBC and Standard Chartered Complete First Live Transaction on Swift Blockchain Ledger
entry.summary: Swift’s ledger matched and netted obligations recorded on the banks’ separate platforms, but final settlement still ran through existing systems.

entry.title: Maya Protocol Exploit Drains $1.7 Million From Shared Liquidity
entry.summary: Founder Aaluxx said he would ‘work to fix and recover in full,’ while routing service LeoDex reported that Maya had activated a global halt.

entry.title: Gnosis Chain to Abandon Its Validator Set and Settle to Ethereum
entry.summary: GnosisDAO approved a strategic shift from standalone Layer 1 to an Ethereum-settled rollup, unlocking about 350,000 GNO and ending treasury-funded staking rewards.

entry.title: Hayden Adams Says AMMs Will Win The Biggest Markets. A Former XTX Trader Says They're Going To Zero
entry.summary: The Uniswap founder's first blog post since 2019 argues tokenized stocks will trade against index funds instead of dollars. The replies split between investors who called the thesis disruptive and traders who asked who would want to sell NVIDIA for SPY.

entry.title: Aligned Details ALIGN Airdrop 20 Months Later
entry.summary: The ZK infrastructure firm set unlock schedules and claiming networks for 8.74% of supply. It has not dated the token launch, and the site it built for its public auction now says the sale was canceled.

entry.title: Tenev Pushes for Tokenized Stocks in America
entry.summary: The Robinhood CEO published a case for US equity tokenization five days after the SEC shelved its innovation exemption for a second time.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Token Offering Rules With $75 Million Exemption
entry.summary: The proposal pairs two registration exemptions with a conditional safe harbor that would take the "investment contract" label off a token, and preempts state securities law. All three sitting commissioners backed it in a vote held outside a public meeting.

entry.title: Omnichain Launchpad Printr Shuts Down, Cancels Token Launch And Airdrop
entry.summary: Printr said it will cease all operations by Aug. 31 and will not hold the token generation event or airdrop it had promised. The launchpad raised $4.5 million last October and collected 84% of its lifetime fees in a single month.

entry.title: Ansem Launches Site Where Teams Buy His Attention With Airdrops
entry.summary: Projects launching on ansem.io hand at least 3% of supply to holders of his memecoin and burn $ANSEM to rank higher. Every coin created there is a pump.fun token.

entry.title: Deel Takes Its DLUSD Stablecoin Wallet to More Than 80 Countries
entry.summary: The payroll platform's dollar balance, issued through Stripe's Bridge and settled on Tempo, is now live across Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. The US, UK, EU and Australia remain excluded.

entry.title: Neynar Seeks a New Owner for Farcaster Seven Months After Buying It
entry.summary: Protocol fees fell from $35.43 million in the first quarter to $376,740 so far in the third, according to DefiLlama. Neynar says it will return most of its remaining balance sheet and its team will disband.

entry.title: Search Interest in Prediction Markets Falls 83% From Its World Cup Peak as Kalshi Pulls Away
entry.summary: Google Trends set its five-year high for "prediction market" the week the 2026 World Cup opened, and its single-day high on the day of the final. Category volume hit a record in July. August is pacing lower on both, and Polymarket is falling behind Kalshi faster than the mindshare data suggests.

entry.title: Compound Foundation Names Coinbase And Anchorage Alumni To Run $52 Million Institutional Push
entry.summary: The DAO approved the two-year budget in May with 1.88 million COMP in favor and none against. Compound holds about $1.2 billion in deposits, against Aave's $14.8 billion.

entry.title: Fake World Assets Opens Its Gacha Pool to New NFT Collections
entry.summary: TokenWorks will let artists issue collections directly into the randomized pool through a mechanism called FWAir, with backers fronting the ETH and creators paid out of trading fees rather than mint proceeds.

entry.title: Stripe’s Reported $7 Billion OpenRouter Deal Buys Micropayments Without a Blockchain
entry.summary: OpenRouter meters AI usage against prepaid deposits and charges 5% on crypto top-ups against 5.5% on card purchases made through Stripe. Stripe co-incubated Tempo to settle machine payments onchain; the chain is running at about one transaction per second.

entry.title: SafePal Breach Exposes 39,798 Buyers as Stolen Records Hit Cybercrime Forum
entry.summary: The wallet maker says a flaw in an order-tracking plug-in leaked names, phone numbers and shipping addresses over 14 months. A seller is now advertising the file.

entry.title: Tether Clears First Full Audit From KPMG Without Publishing the Statements
entry.summary: The Big Four firm issued an unqualified opinion on 2025 accounts for Tether's El Salvador issuing entity. The work was done to AICPA standards rather than the PCAOB standards the GENIUS Act sets for licensed U.S. issuers, and Tether has released neither the statements nor the opinion letter.

entry.title: Norway Wealth Fund Discloses $81.9 Million BitMine Stake
entry.summary: The fund reported holding 6.15 million BMNR shares at June 30, giving it indirect Ethereum exposure through a listed company.

entry.title: Tempo Launches Embedded Yield Product for Platforms, Starting With Deel
entry.summary: Tempo Earn routes rewards through Morpho vaults and tokenized money market funds, placing the payment outside the stablecoin issuer that US law bars from paying interest. Deel's contractor wallet is the first named deployment, at a promotional target rate of up to 4% APY.

entry.title: Standard Chartered Says Its $100 UNI Target May Be Too Low After Robinhood Chain Burns
entry.summary: Geoff Kendrick says UNI burns funded by Robinhood Chain trading have run at an annualized $90 million since Jul. 27. DefiLlama data puts Uniswap's protocol revenue at 2.4 times its prior level, with Robinhood Chain supplying about 60% of it.

entry.title: SharpLink Plans $200 Million ETH Allocation to Lido’s wstETH
entry.summary: Using Kraken’s displayed $1,889.84 ETH price, the planned allocation equates to about 106,000 ETH, roughly 12% of SharpLink’s reported holdings.

entry.title: Neutrl Pauses Minting and Redemptions While Assessing Reserve Impact
entry.summary: Strata paused minting, redemptions and related functions on its Neutrl market contracts, whose two tranche tokens carried more than $1.7 million in displayed onchain value.

entry.title: Robinhood Private-Market Fund Prices $200 Million IPO
entry.summary: RVII pays its adviser a 2% annual base fee and a 20% realized-gains incentive fee; some exposure may use illiquid vehicles.

entry.title: Trezor Shipping-Provider Breach Exposes Data of 13,689 Customers
entry.summary: ShipMonk incident exposed names and contact details of recent customers in seven countries; Trezor says its devices and systems were not compromised.

entry.title: ether.fi Adds Tokenized Stocks, New Fiat Rails And Aave-Backed Borrowing
entry.summary: The Summer release lands a week after the protocol pulled restaking out of weETH. The release also introduces programmatic ETHFI buybacks funded from every revenue line.

entry.title: Securitize’s Tokenized Assets Hit $4.3 Billion as Revenue Falls
entry.summary: Tokenization revenue dropped 12% and operating costs jumped 56%, showing that higher onchain assets have yet to produce steadier earnings.

entry.title: Uniswap Founder Says Team Renounced Creator Fees From Employee Testing
entry.summary: TradePools said test tokens built while developing Pools no longer send creator fees to Uniswap Labs, with past and future fees redirected to an ETH-for-burn mechanism.

entry.title: Boltz Founders Exit as Unnamed Bitcoin Group Agrees to Take Over Suspended Swap Service
entry.summary: The service remains offline while incoming operators work to fix vulnerabilities; Boltz said attacks caused losses to the company.

entry.title: Circle’s cirBTC Is Live on Ethereum but Has Only 40 BTC Outstanding
entry.summary: Circle National Trust custodies the backing, while published Bitcoin addresses and Chainlink Proof of Reserve provide onchain visibility; Arc support remains forthcoming.

entry.title: BitGo CFO to Exit as Q2 Net Loss Hits $19 Million
entry.summary: Revenue jumped 80%, but trading and staking margins weakened as BitGo targeted $15 million in annualized savings following June layoffs.

entry.title: SEC Staff Clears Franklin Funds to Use Onchain Money Fund for Cash and Collateral
entry.summary: The relief lets Franklin Templeton’s registered funds hold FOBXX through an affiliated blockchain-integrated system, subject to 12 custody and control conditions.

entry.title: Pump.fun's Share Of Launchpad Fees Fell To 27% In July. Four Weeks Later It's Back Above Half
entry.summary: Two launchpads on Robinhood Chain cut pump.fun's share of launchpad fees from 80% to 27% in two weeks. Pump.fun's fees are up 30% over 30 days anyway, because the category grew 77% around it. Memecoin prices did not participate.

entry.title: Marinade Says 28.83% of Solana Stake Went Delinquent, Nearing Finality Halt
entry.summary: Teraswitch confirmed a 12-site routing failure; Marinade said 94% of the 118.89 million SOL on its autonomous system went dark.

entry.title: SEC Advances Tokenized-Securities Exemption That Could Enable 24/7 Trading
entry.summary: Atkins says the framework would support compliant onchain trading while long-term rules are developed; Friday's scheduled Commission consideration covers a separate offering proposal.

entry.title: Solana Community Argues Over Whether Its Foundation Should Pick Winners
entry.summary: Flash.Trade's founder said Foundation backing for a rival contributed to his decision to wind the perps exchange down. Foundation president Lily Liu says the market decides who wins.

entry.title: Bitwise Cuts 14% of Staff as Client Assets Fall to $9 Billion
entry.summary: The crypto asset manager reduced headcount to about 155 from 180, while its BITW index fund ended June with $532.8 million in net assets, down from $1.03 billion at year-end.

entry.title: Harmony Patches Pre-Staking Quorum and Receipt-Replay Flaws After ONE Mint Claim
entry.summary: Harmony asked exchanges to block four wallets and paused its bridge, while an analyst’s estimate of four billion unauthorized ONE remains unconfirmed.

entry.title: Barça Mobile Plans Stellar Wallet With Wirex and Crossmint
entry.summary: Wirex will provide payment and card infrastructure, Crossmint will handle wallet onboarding, and Stellar will supply the blockchain layer for the planned feature.

entry.title: CFTC Sues Goliath Ventures Over Alleged $397M DeFi Liquidity Pool Ponzi
entry.summary: The complaint says $87 million went to Ponzi payments, $174 million to recruiter commissions and $48 million to CEO Christopher Delgado's personal spending, with recoveries for roughly 1,600 customers now running through a bankruptcy estate.

entry.title: Riot Signs $9.1B, 20-Year AI Data Center Lease at Its Texas Bitcoin Mine
entry.summary: The 20-year lease is projected to average $457 million a year, while Riot's fully costed bitcoin mining ran at 126.5% of the value of the coins it produced last quarter.

entry.title: Stablecoin Card Issuer Rain Buys Merchant Wallet Startup Ansa
entry.summary: Ansa builds branded prepaid wallets that hold dollar balances for merchants, with no stablecoin leg. Founder Sophia Goldberg joins Rain as head of payments, and terms were not disclosed.

entry.title: ENS Tokenholders Hand Endowment Control to a Staffed Foundation
entry.summary: The proposal passed with 1.27 million ENS in favor and 480,690 against. Co-founder Alex Van de Sande voted no after decoding the executable, arguing the DAO disappears from the endowment's control chain.

entry.title: Coinbase Wins Abu Dhabi License for Tokenized Securities Hub
entry.summary: The FSRA permission covers arranging deals in investments and custody. Coinbase has not named a launch date, and the fine print limits which token holders can vote their shares.
